name: Dimensional Wave
body:
School conjuration (dimensional); Level sorcerer/wizard 7

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S

EFFECT

Range personal
Area 30-ft.-radius emanation centered on you
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

When you cast this spell, a powerful wave erupts from your body in all directions, warping space around you.

The wave crashes over friends and foes, dealing 1d6 hp force damage per caster level (maximum 20d6 hp damage) to all creatures (except you) within 10 ft. It deals 1d4 hp force damage per caster level (maximum 20d4 hp damage) to all creatures between 11 and 30 ft. A successful save halves the damage.
